notes.title: Oh hi there! How about a holiday update?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997912/4f72214c3cd4af6a2d3b6023c64de8a90d325af6.png[/img]
[h1]Long time no explode! [/h1]

As you probably know, we've been hard at work on our other game, Children of the Eclipse, and sadly Exploding Babies has been left in a hot car with no A/C on for FAR to long without any attention or nutrients. 

[h3]But DON'T WORRY! We're here to take care of the situation.[/h3]

We've been preparing something excellent for you guys. A holiday update is in the works, prepped for release THIS FRIDAY. We've got all sorts of cool stuff coming your way. Here's a few:

[h2]GRAPHICS OVERHAUL![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997912/ea79eca13d963b7e0835c2454773e5d783f0dba8.jpg[/img]
We wanted to make the game JUST a bit less dark, but still appropriately twisted, so we went for a more cartoony look. We're also hoping to release the game on Switch, so a clearer image will help make sense of the action even on a smaller screen. 

[h2]NEW BABY - ?[/h2]
Yes - the new baby will be very holiday seasony.

[h2]NEW GAME MODE - TEAM DEATHMATCH[/h2]
Like regular deathmatch, but now split into two teams for more coordinated (you wish) exploding!

[h2]A BUNCH OF TWEAKS![/h2]
An impressive pile of bug fixes, tweaks to game modes and maps, better CPU AI for single player goodness etc etc...

[h2]UPDATE DISCOUNT![/h2]
We're planning to kick off the launch of the update with a discount, so now is the perfect time to get the game, or if you already have it, tell your friends to get it too!

Wishlist the game and/or follow us on Steam or social media to get the latest news!
